subject: english
title: My Only Cry
author: Leila Ibrahim Semaan
instructions: Literature practice for this lesson in the question types of the April 2026 paper.
Where a question has OR, answer either one.
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

sections.title: Identify the following sentences as True or False.

questions.q: The poem 'My Only Cry' is written by Leila Ibrahim Semaan.
Children cannot rebuild what the adults destroy.
Right-wing and left-wing politics matter a lot to children.
Children don't want wars to break out.
The child asks the arms makers to continue producing weapons.
The poem is written in rhyming verse.

sections.title: Match the character (or speaker) with the description.

questions.right: appeals to adults to close the arms factories
questions.answer: The child speaker — appeals to adults to close the arms factories

questions.right: make arms, wars and false promises
questions.answer: The adults — make arms, wars and false promises

sections.title: Read the passage and fill in the blanks.

questions.q: The children's cries are useless in a ________ world.
The child does not want to talk of friendship, peace and ________.
These words should be spoken by ________.

sections.passage:
You know that our cries are useless,
in a deaf world.
Now, my friends, let's not talk of friendship,
Peace and fellowship,
these words should be spoken by adults.

sections.title: Read the passage and fill in the blanks.

questions.q: The children ask the adults to close their arms ________.
They ask them to think about taming the ________.
Right-wing politics matter ________ to the children.

sections.passage:
So, in your name, we children, we ask them:
"Close your arms factories
and think about taming the winds."
Right-wing politics matter little to us,
we are children.

questions.q: The child says, 'I don't know how to ________ like you.'
A better world cannot be rebuilt without the ________.
Through the adults' fault, a veil of ________ lies over the children's life.
The children's life is essentially ________.

sections.title: Answer in one or two sentences (about 30 words).

questions.q: What can't the children rebuild?
questions.answer: The children cannot rebuild what the adults destroy through wars and weapons.

questions.q: Why does the child call the world 'deaf'?
questions.answer: Because the adults do not listen to the children's cries for peace; their pleas go unheard.

questions.q: What, according to the child, lies buried under a veil of dust?
questions.answer: The children's life, which is essentially affection, lies under a veil of dust because of the adults' wars and weapons.

questions.q: What does the child ask the adults to stop doing?
questions.answer: To stop making arms, to stop making wars break out and to stop telling lies.

questions.q: In 'My Only Cry', what does the child plead with the adults to speak about?
questions.answer: Peace, friendship and fellowship — the child says these words should be spoken by adults, who make the wars.

questions.q: What is the central message of the poem 'My Only Cry'?
questions.answer: It is an appeal by the children of the world to adults to close the arms factories and stop wars and lies. Children cannot rebuild what adults destroy; their life is full of affection but is covered with dust by adults' weapons. Adults must use their energy for peaceful work and build a better world.

or.q: Why does the child say that words like friendship, peace and fellowship should be spoken by adults?
or.answer: Adults make the weapons and start the wars, so only they can bring peace. Children's cries are useless in a deaf world; it is the adults who must keep their promises, stop the wars and bring friendship and fellowship.
